decision.observation: 8 mph, gear 1, timer 33:25.599, red X cleared, dots pale. Car is well off the gravel on the right-hand grass, nose up-frame into the pines; the road runs along the lower-left of frame, white posts marking its edge, red/white hut up-left.
decision.hypothesis: The rightward drift continued through the left bend and put the car deep on the grass. Nose points up-frame into trees, so forward travel leads further off-road; a reverse with left steer should translate it down-frame and swing the nose back toward the gravel.
decision.memory: Car has gone fully off-road again at only 7-8 mph, so the drift is heading-related, not purely speed-related; S+A reverse has been the reliable way to both clear trees and re-aim onto the gravel.
